data.title: 神罚 · 星空晚宴露台的黑金礼服
data.description: 方舟高层和平晚宴的安静露台上，头顶是久违的晴朗星空。神罚身穿修身的黑金丝绒无袖晚礼服，高开衩的裙摆随夜风轻扬，露出如霜雪般匀称的长腿。银白短发微卷，机械发饰在星光下闪烁着微芒。平日里单纯如孩童的少女，在华贵礼服衬托下展现出惊艳绝伦的端庄与动人温存。
data.location: grand banquet terrace under starry night sky overlooking illuminated city
data.action: leaning against terrace railing in black velvet evening gown, gold trim, high side leg slit, looking at viewer with innocent affectionate smile
data.lighting: soft starlight and warm terrace ambient floor uplights
data.mood: grand fairy-tale romance, pure heartwarming elegance
data.promptProse: Standing on a starlit banquet terrace overlooking the glowing city, Modernia wears a luxurious black velvet evening gown with a high side slit. Her silver bob hair glistens under starlight as she smiles with gentle, innocent affection.
data.animaCaption: Modernia standing on a starlit balcony in an elegant black velvet gown, smiling sweetly.
